steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual. Replace all parts before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Stuck button check
steps.body: Verify no button pressed >30 s. Check control panel deformation and sub PBA screw torque.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify no button pressed >30 s. Check control panel deformation and sub PBA screw torque.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Relieve panel deformation or replace sub PBA/control panel.

steps.title: Repair panel/PBA
steps.oemOutcome: Correct mechanical bind or replace sub PBA when switch stuck.

steps.title: Switch path OK
steps.oemOutcome: No stuck buttons — replace sub PBA if BC2 persists.
